name: deepseek
description: DeepSeek list prices in USD per 1M tokens at the PEAK (standard) rate. DeepSeek halves every price during off-peak hours (01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC on weekdays, excluding CN holidays); usage logs only carry a date, so switching to off-peak prices is a pricing-profile decision. Copy this file, halve the numbers, and load it as an override profile if your traffic is off-peak.
